Searching for additional format edge cases: `#` markers, table-in-options, and other rare layouts.

[REDACTED]

# HKDSE Physics MC Question Format Taxonomy

Systematic sampling across all 17 folders (2012-2026, `pp`, `sap`; 33 questions/year except 36 for 2012/2013/pp/sap). Roughly 5+ questions per year reviewed, with targeted reads for rare layouts.

---

## 1. Master layout archetypes

These are the top-level structural patterns. Most questions fit one primary archetype plus modifiers from sections 2-4.

| ID | Format name | Stem | Options | Examples |
|----|-------------|------|---------|----------|
| **A** | Text-only stem, text-only options | Prose (sometimes sentence-completion) | 4 vertical text lines | 2015/q21, 2016/q20, 2013/q33, 2025/q22, 2026/q32, sap/q20 |
| **B** | Diagram in stem, text-only options | 1+ figure(s) + prose | 4 vertical text/numeric lines | 2012/q1, 2014/q25, 2016/q27, 2019/q31, pp/q30, sap/q1 |
| **C** | Diagram in stem, numeric options | Figure + calculation stem | Values with units | 2014/q10, 2013/q5, 2019/q16, 2019/q24, 2021/q23, 2024/q11 |
| **D** | Diagram in stem, equation-heavy options | Figure + prose | Algebraic expressions, fractions, ratios | 2012/q8, 2020/q9, 2022/q6, 2015/q30 |
| **E** | Text-only stem, combination-of-statements | Prose + numbered (1)(2)(3) | "(1) and (2) only" etc. | 2018/q13, sap/q33, sap/q20 |
| **F** | Diagram in stem, combination-of-statements | Figure + numbered statements | Combination options | 2012/q22, 2017/q11, 2021/q18, 2022/q15, 2022/q28, 2026/q8, 2026/q16, pp/q4, pp/q17, 2012/q33 |
| **G** | Diagram in stem, tabular options | Figure + prose | 2-column table with headers | 2014/q18, 2017/q2, 2017/q19, 2018/q29, 2020/q26, 2023/q6, 2023/q25, 2021/q30, 2015/q30, pp/q33 |
| **H** | Text/diagram stem, graph options | Text or figure sets up scenario | 4 graphs (usually 2x2 grid) | 2015/q7, 2012/q18, 2023/q10, 2024/q7, 2025/q6 |
| **I** | Text/diagram stem, image-per-option | Stem figure + "which below?" | 4 schematic/graphic choices | 2012/q30, 2013/q28, 2018/q20, 2020/q17, 2021/q5, 2023/q18, 2024/q15 |
| **J** | Table in stem, text/symbol options | Prose + data table | Text, inequalities, or numeric | 2026/q24, sap/q9 |
| **K** | Multi-figure stem (no combo) | 2+ labeled figures + prose | Text or numeric | 2012/q15, 2016/q11, 2017/q11, 2018/q29, 2024/q7, 2025/q6 |
| **L** | Equation/nuclear reaction in stem | Centered reaction equation | Numeric or comparative text | 2022/q33, 2025/q33, 2014/q33 |

---

## 2. Stem structure variations

### 2.1 Diagram placement
- **Figure-first** (diagram above text): 2012/q8, 2014/q10, 2019/q16 - most common when a figure exists.
- **Text-first, figure below**: 2018/q8, 2020/q1, 2021/q18.
- **Split stem** (text - diagram - text): 2020/q1, 2023/q6, 2019/q31, 2012/q18, 2026/q24.
- **Text-only**: 2016/q3, 2021/q12, 2024/q3, 2025/q31.

### 2.2 Figure count and labeling
| Sub-type | Labels | Examples |
|----------|--------|----------|
| Single schematic | - | 2013/q5, 2016/q27, 2025/q14 |
| `(a)` / `(b)` time-sequence pair | lowercase letters | 2012/q15 |
| Side-by-side comparison | (a)/(b) or left/right | 2016/q11, 2018/q29 |
| Roman numeral figures | (I), (II), (III) | 2012/q22 |
| Method comparison | (I) and (II) with sub-diagrams | 2017/q11 |
| Stem diagram + reference graph | Figure (a) schematic + (b) graph | 2024/q7 |
| Stem schematic + v-t graph side-by-side | - | 2025/q6 |
| Multiple free-body diagrams | side-by-side boxes | 2026/q8 |
| Photograph / realistic image | X, Y labels | 2014/q1 |

### 2.3 Graph in stem (not in options)
- Cooling / phase-change curve: 2023/q2, 2017/q2
- Displacement-distance with two time snapshots: 2022/q15
- Reference v-t or E_k-s graph as given data: 2025/q6, 2024/q7

### 2.4 Table in stem
- **2-column data table** (condition | value): 2026/q24 (`only X` / `180 s`, `only Y` / `300 s`)
- **2-column scenario table** (situation | reading): sap/q9 (`Motion of lift` | `R_1/R_2/R_3`)
- No full data table found **inside options**; "tabular options" use column headers but are answer choices, not reference data.

### 2.5 Equation-heavy stem
- Inline fractions/variables: 2020/q33
- Display nuclear equation with isotope notation: 2022/q33 (`²³⁵U + ¹n → ...`)
- Simple fusion arrow: 2025/q33 (`X + Y → Z`)
- Sub-statements as bare variables: 2018/q13 (`(1) r`, `(2) m`, `(3) M`)

---

## 3. Option format variations

### 3.1 Text-only (vertical list)
| Sub-type | Content | Examples |
|----------|---------|----------|
| Full sentences | Qualitative explanations | 2012/q1, 2015/q21, 2018/q4, pp/q30 |
| Sentence completion | Stem ends with comma; options finish sentence | 2016/q20, 2026/q1 |
| Short noun phrases | Appliance names | 2013/q33 |
| Variable pairs | `Q and R` | 2020/q1 |
| Label sets | `P and Q` | 2016/q27 |
| Qualitative inequality | `greater than 2a`, `between a and 2a` | 2018/q8 |
| Meta / conditional | "cannot be found...", "depends on θ" | 2013/q12, 2016/q11, 2022/q4 |

### 3.2 Numeric options
| Sub-type | Examples |
|----------|----------|
| SI values + units | 2014/q10, 2013/q5, 2019/q24 |
| Integer counts | 2019/q16 (3, 4, 6, 7) |
| Scientific notation | 2014/q33 (`5.4 × 10⁻¹¹ kg less`) |
| Powers of ten | 2024/q3 (`10⁴`, `10⁶`, `10⁸`, `10¹²`) |
| Time of day | 2021/q12 (`6:53 a.m.` ...) |
| Ratio `a : b` | 2018/q25, 2020/q33, 2020/q9 |
| Ranking sequences | 2025/q14 (`X Y Z`, `Y Z X`, ...) |

### 3.3 Equation / symbolic options
- Single expressions: 2022/q6 (`Mg`, `(M+m)g`, `Mg + mg cos θ`)
- Fractions: 2012/q8 (`(2F₁-F₂)/3`, ...)
- Tabular algebraic pairs: 2015/q30 (`I/4` | `V/2`), pp/q33 (`0` | `2BL²`)
- Inequality chains: sap/q9 (`R₁ = R₂ > R₃`, ...)

### 3.4 Tabular / multi-column options
Two column headers with 4 rows (A-D). Very common for "compare two quantities" questions.

| Header pattern | Examples |
|----------------|----------|
| Two locations (O \| P) | 2014/q18 (constructive/destructive) |
| Two properties (melting point \| latent heat) | 2017/q2 |
| Two image properties (nature \| distance) | 2017/q19 |
| Choice + reason | 2018/q29 (drops slower \| reason) |
| Two directions (Earth's field \| force) | 2020/q26 (arrow symbols) |
| Before / after state | 2023/q6 |
| Primary \| secondary coil taps | 2021/q30 |
| Two rotation angles (90° \| 180°) | pp/q33 |
| Current \| Hall voltage | 2015/q30 |
| Direction \| magnitude | 2023/q25 |

**Schema note:** Treat as `option_table` with `columns[]` and `rows[A-D]`, not a free-form table.

### 3.5 Combination-of-statements options
Standard HKDSE "which statements" pattern:
- 3 numbered statements (1)(2)(3), occasionally horizontal layout of candidates
- Options: `(1) only`, `(1) and (2) only`, `(1), (2) and (3)`, etc.

| Statement content | Examples |
|-------------------|----------|
| Prose physics claims | 2012/q22, 2022/q15, pp/q17 |
| Numeric speed candidates | 2014/q7, 2019/q11 |
| Variable pairs (short-circuit points) | 2012/q33 |
| Variable dependencies | 2018/q13 |
| **Diagram candidates** labeled (1)(2)(3) | 2015/q14 (waveform shapes; options say "(1) only") |

### 3.6 Graph / image options
| Layout | Content | Examples |
|--------|---------|----------|
| 2x2 grid | v-t, T-t, E_p/E_k-s graphs | 2015/q7, 2023/q10, 2024/q7, 2025/q6 |
| 2x2 grid | Force vectors, field directions | 2012/q30, 2013/q28, 2021/q5 |
| 2x2 grid | Wave reflection patterns | 2024/q15 |
| Vertical stack | Displacement-time graphs | 2012/q18 |
| Vertical stack | Spectral line patterns | 2023/q18 |
| Vertical stack | Digit "4" orientations (mirror/periscope) | 2020/q17, 2018/q20 |
| Vertical stack | Lightning-bolt design rotations | 2018/q20 |

### 3.7 Mixed text + diagram per option
Each option = short text label + small modified diagram:
- 2017/q27 (eddy current scenarios)
- Less common than pure image-per-option

---

## 4. Special markers and typography

| Marker | Observed? | Meaning (in sample) | Examples |
|--------|-----------|---------------------|----------|
| `*` prefix | **Yes, frequent** | Extended / non-routine questions | 2014/q10, 2016/q3, 2017/q19, 2020/q9, 2021/q30, 2024/q3, 2024/q20, 2024/q30, 2025/q30, 2014/q33, 2025/q33, pp/q33, sap/q33 |
| `#` prefix | **Not found** in ~80+ sampled crops across all years | - | - |
| **Bold** in stem | Yes | Emphasis on key condition | 2015/q21 (`Any two of them`), 2020/q1 (`a short duration`), 2021/q5 (resultant force phrase), 2023/q6/10 (`rough`), 2020/q26 (`NOT`) |
| `END OF SECTION A` | Yes on q33 | Section boundary footer | 2022/q33, 2023/q33, 2014/q33, 2025/q33, 2020/q33 |
| Parenthetical constants | Yes | `g = 9.81 m s⁻²`, `Neglect air resistance` | 2014/q10, 2015/q7 |
| `(i.e. ...)` gloss | Yes | 2019/q16 (`minimum amplitude`) |

---

## 5. Cross-cutting modifiers (combine with archetypes)

These stack on top of the base formats above:

1. **Multi-part stem prompt** - intro text, then "Which of the following is correct?"
2. **Given + find structure** - data in stem/diagram/table, single numeric target
3. **Compare two methods/scenarios** - side-by-side figures or A vs B diagrams
4. **Perspective / view transformation** - 3D stem, 2D cross-section options (2013/q28)
5. **Mirror / rotation identification** - stem shows result, options show originals (2018/q20, 2020/q17)
6. **"Best represents" / "best shows"** - qualitative diagram selection (2024/q15, 2023/q18)
7. **Dotted vs solid overlay graphs** - stem gives solid reference; options add dotted variant (2024/q7)

---

## 6. Recommended database schema fields

```yaml
question:
  year: string          # 2012-2026 | pp | sap
  number: int           # 1-33 (36 for 2012/2013/pp/sap)
  markers: [asterisk]   # enum; # not observed
  section_footer: bool  # END OF SECTION A on q33

stem:
  layout: enum          # text_only | figure_first | text_first | split_text_figure_text
  text_blocks: int      # 1-3
  has_bold_emphasis: bool
  has_table: bool
  table:
    columns: [string]
    rows: [{col: value}]
  figures:
    - id: string        # a, b, I, II, main, etc.
      type: enum        # schematic | graph | photo | circuit | ray | fbd | 3d
      count: int

statements:             # for combo formats
  style: enum           # prose | numeric | variable | diagram | none
  layout: enum          # vertical | horizontal
  items: [{number: 1, content: ...}]

options:
  layout: enum          # vertical | grid_2x2 | tabular
  type: enum            # text | numeric | equation | ratio | ranking |
                         # combo_statements | graph | image | mixed_text_image |
                         # tabular_text | tabular_symbol
  columns: [string]     # if tabular
  has_meta_option: bool # "cannot be found"
  items: [A, B, C, D]
```

---

## 7. Coverage summary by year (samples reviewed)

| Year | Samples | Formats seen |
|------|---------|--------------|
| 2012 | q1,8,15,18,22,30,33 | B, D, K, H, F, I, F |
| 2013 | q5,12,28,33 | B, C, I, A |
| 2014 | q1,7,10,18,25,33 | B (photo), F+numeric, C, G, B, L |
| 2015 | q7,14,21,30 | H, F+diagram-stmts, A, G+equation |
| 2016 | q3,11,20,27 | A+*, K, A, B |
| 2017 | q2,11,19,27 | G+graph, F+methods, G+*, mixed opts |
| 2018 | q8,13,20,25,29 | B, E, I, A+ratio, G+multi-fig |
| 2019 | q11,16,24,31 | F+numeric, B+numeric, C, B |
| 2020 | q1,9,17,26,33 | split B, D+*, I, G+symbols, L |
| 2021 | q5,12,18,23,30 | I, A+time, F, C, G+* |
| 2022 | q4,6,15,28,33 | B+meta, D, F+graph, F, L |
| 2023 | q2,6,10,18,25,33 | graph B, G+split, H, I, G, A |
| 2024 | q3,7,11,15,20,30 | A+10^n, H+multi-fig, C, I, A+*, A+* |
| 2025 | q6,14,22,31,33 | H+multi-fig, B+ranking, A, A, L+* |
| 2026 | q1,8,16,24,32 | A, F+multi-fbd, F, J, A |
| pp | q4,17,30,33 | F, F, B, G+* |
| sap | q1,9,20,33 | B, J, E, E+* |

---

## 8. Notable absences / low frequency

- **`#` marker**: not observed in any sampled question across 2012-2026, pp, sap.
- **Full data table in options**: not found; tabular options use headers + cell values, not reference tables.
- **More than 2 option columns**: all tabular options seen are 2-column; pp/q33 is 2 columns x 2 conditions.
- **5+ options**: always exactly A-D.
- **Roman numerals in combo statements**: figures use (I)(II)(III); statement lists use (1)(2)(3).

---

## 9. Highest-priority distinct formats for schema (15 types)

1. **Plain text MC** - no visuals
2. **Stem diagram + text options**
3. **Stem diagram + numeric options**
4. **Stem diagram + equation options**
5. **Stem graph + numeric options**
6. **Multi-figure stem + text/numeric options**
7. **Stem table + numeric options**
8. **Combo statements (prose) + combo options**
9. **Combo statements (numeric/diagram candidates) + combo options**
10. **Tabular 2-column text options**
11. **Tabular 2-column symbolic/equation options**
12. **Graph-per-option (2x2)**
13. **Diagram-per-option (2x2 or vertical)**
14. **Mixed text+mini-diagram per option**
15. **Nuclear/equation stem + comparative numeric text options**

This taxonomy should cover essentially all layout variation in the corpus; the main parsing challenge is detecting **tabular headers**, **combo-statement blocks**, and **2x2 image grids** vs simple vertical lists.
